title: Pop-Up Dinner Seating Mixer from Gemini Flash
description: A two-prompt Gemini Flash source run that produced a self-contained pop-up dinner seating mixer for adding guests, recording dietary notes and acquaintance tags, reshuffling balanced tables, clearing/resetting, and printing a seating plan.
model_settings: Gemini web in logged-in Chrome; visible mode picker label Flash; default visible mode; no uploaded files, custom tools, or custom settings visible; no OpenRouter fallback used.
source_url_note: Real Gemini conversation URL captured from the logged-in Chrome session; not a public share URL. Gemini exposed the visible model label as Flash; no more specific backend version was visible.
final_artifact_clue: Open the artifact, load demo data or add guests, set a target table size, click Mix Seating repeatedly, and confirm the table layouts change while dietary alerts and guest tags remain visible.

artifact_versions.notes: Prompt 1 artifact. It rendered and worked, but repeated Mix Seating clicks produced deterministic arrangements, so prompt 2 was justified.
Final artifact from prompt 2. Gemini added shuffleArray plus randomized table assignment order while keeping tag spreading and the single-file HTML structure.

verification_notes: Verified final artifact over local HTTP at http://127.0.0.1:8176/artifacts/popup-dinner-seating-mixer-gemini.html. Rendered nonblank with title, add guest form, target table size, Mix Seating, Print Layout, Load Demo Data, Clear All, roster, and seating layout output. Prompt 1 rendered and add/mix/clear worked, but repeated Mix Seating was deterministic, which justified prompt 2. Prompt 2 verification loaded demo data, set table size to 3, clicked Mix Seating six times, and observed six distinct layouts. Added Mira Santos with Vegetarian / Chef friends and confirmed roster count increased to 13, then Clear All reset count to 0 and removed table cards. Static checks confirmed no external script/link/image/@import URLs in the saved artifact files and script syntax compiled. Chrome dev console error logs were empty. Chrome DOM inspection reported an injected Google Fonts stylesheet that is not present in the saved files; treated as browser/page-environment noise, not an artifact dependency. Print Layout control is present and statically wired to window.print(). Direct 390px viewport resizing was not exposed by this lane browser API, but source review shows a one-column grid below 768px and tables at minmax(280px, 1fr), which should fit a 390px viewport with normal body/card padding.
result_content: A self-contained pop-up dinner seating mixer with guest entry, dietary note tags, acquaintance group tags, table-size controls, repeated randomized mixing, dietary alert badges, clear/reset, local persistence, and print-friendly styling.

steps.prompt_exact: Can you make a self-contained HTML seating mixer for a pop-up dinner that lets me add guests with dietary notes and acquaintance tags, then shuffle them into balanced tables with a print-friendly seating plan?
steps.response_summary: Gemini produced a complete single-file HTML pop-up dinner seating mixer with guest entry, dietary restrictions, acquaintance tags, target table size, seating layout cards, demo data, clear/reset, localStorage, and print styling. Verification found repeated Mix Seating clicks produced the same arrangement, so prompt 2 was needed.
